children: Niclas Neglen is set to join Adyen
as CFO and a statutory board management member, effective February 1.
plans to transition Neglen in early 2027.
Adyen's supervisory board is set to propose his appointment as a management board member to shareholders at an extraordinary general meeting, subject to regulatory approval by the Dutch Central Bank.
In May, Adyen CFO Ethan Tandowsky announced his resignation, effective August 31. Hwa Tsao was appointed interim CFO.

"Hwa Tsao's dedicated leadership keeps our finance organization operating at full strength. His oversight as interim CFO through February 1, 2027, will allow for a seamless transition before he resumes leading our finance operations as senior vice president of group finance," said Pieter van der Does, co-CEO of Adyen.
KLAR was 2.12% higher at $13.97 during afternoon trading on Tuesday, ADYEY was -0.98% to $10.14.
